_comment: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) texts for the German table tourney_watch. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.No final was played yet. Come back after: 還沒有進行過決賽。週末過後再來。
strings.None of your friends is in a live duel r: 你的好友現在都不在即時對決中。
strings.Round %d (you see it one move later): 第%d回合（你會延後一步看到）
